Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class ReleaseBenchmarkApplicability

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.ReleaseBenchmarkApplicability
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ReleaseBenchmarkApplicability extends Object implements Serializable
Fail-closed applicability check between a published withdrawal phase and a release result.

A numerical rate is not experimental validation when the model's resolved upstream material phase differs from the experimental withdrawal phase. This helper retains that distinction without modifying either the immutable request or result.

  • Method Details

    • assess

      public static ReleaseBenchmarkApplicability assess(ReleaseFlowResult result, ReleaseBenchmarkApplicability.ExpectedPhase expectedPhase)
      Assesses whether a release result represents the published withdrawal phase.

      Unusable model results return ReleaseBenchmarkApplicability.Status.RESULT_UNUSABLE and retain their diagnostic codes. No station or rate is recovered from a failed result.

      Parameters:
      result - release result
      expectedPhase - phase withdrawn in the external experiment
      Returns:
      immutable applicability assessment
